name: Jayena (Spain)
description: White field with a blue bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the arms of Jayena beneath a marquess's crown (five yellow pomegranates on blue within a white bordure).
history: Jayena adopted its arms and flag officially on 12 May 2005; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, white, with a blue bend from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly and the municipal arms superimposed at the centre.
